notes.title: Update - Improved movement and dragon control
notes.content:
0.170120

This version improves the movement and summoning of help from the dragons. It also adds more explanation of the story.  
- Added the ability to tag the dragon from a distance 
- Increased range of movement
- The momentum based physics is more responsive
- Adjusted the difficulty and timing for some levels 
- Continued improvements to the tutorials and in game tips

notes.title: Update - Added new power up levels, mini game, more tutorials
notes.content:
0.170116

Loads of additions. The most important is that voice overs, tutorials, and mini games have been expanded so players can learn about various game mechanics and behavior of the invaders and dragons while playing. 

Rewards and levels to increase dragon stats have been added to each of the mini games. 

Removed the pause from slow move so move happens as soon as the trigger is released. 

- Added mini game (dragon tag) within Tera
- Simplified slow move locomotion
- Added voice tutorials and hints for main gameplay
- Improved game play for all levels leading to the final stage
- Added dragon rewards and level ups in mini games
- Added astral plane to preview levels
- Changed tutorials to reflect above
- Minor cosmetic change

notes.title: Tips for using the staff to strike or swing
notes.content:
Here are some techniques for better physical motions when striking with the staff. I've also posted a video that shows how to combine striking with movement and catching for more power in attacks.  

[list]

[*] Time the swings to hit the rock/shot/etc when the staff is moving with maximum forward velocity towards the target. The target is the enemy that the shot came from. It's better to swing slightly early than slightly late. 

[*] Swinging the arm is the primary motion (like swinging a baseball bat or tennis racket) 

[*] Wrist motions help when combined with arm motions. Try not to rely on the wrist only, which usually results in weak shots, but combining both works well.

[*] Large swings work better than short/quick strokes. The game physics favor well timed, large and fast swings rather than quick strokes.  

[*] Large swings work better than short ones, so step to the side or duck so the incoming shot is off to the side or overhead when striking. 

[/list]

Combine the techniques above with movement and catching to score maximum power on attacks. The attack damage increases with the velocity of the strike, which includes forward movements.  

http://steamcommunity.com/app/553530/videos/
